strings.jp:
ちょいそこのおっさん!
ジャマだからどきなさいよね~
strings.en:
Hey there, old geezer!
You're in the way, so move~

strings.jp:
く、来るな!　来るんじゃない!
来ないでくれ!
strings.en:
D-don't come! Stay back!
Please, don't come near me!

strings.jp:
ヒィィー!
わしゃ、死ぬのは嫌だぁぁぁ!
strings.en:
Eeeek! This old man
doesn't want to diiie!

strings.jp:
そういう人ほど
早く死んじゃうもんだわさ
strings.en:
Folks like that always
kick the bucket early~

strings.jp:
た、助けてくれ!
わしゃ、何も知らなかったんだ!
strings.en:
H-help me! This old man
didn't know anything!

strings.jp: あたしだって知らないわよ!

ハ…ハハハハ……み、見たか!
わ、わしの強さ、思い知ったか!?
strings.en:
Ha... Hahaha... S-see that!?
N-now ya know my might!?

...Somehow that doesn't
sit right with me...
